advisoryStormBody: Tie up support poles, move animals under cover and delay spraying and fertiliser.
advisoryRainTodayBody: Hold off on watering and spraying. Rain will wash the spray off the leaves.
advisoryRainTomorrowBody: Finish spraying today, or wait until the rain has passed.
advisoryHeatBody: Water early in the morning or after sunset, and check young plants for wilting.
advisoryFrostBody: Frost can damage young plants. Light watering in the evening keeps the soil warmer.
advisoryWindBody: Skip spraying today. Wind carries the spray away from your crop.
advisoryDryBody: A good window for spraying, weeding and harvesting. Keep an eye on soil moisture.
alertsIntro: Alerts are matched to your farm location, crops and the latest available forecast.
alertsNoneBody: There are no weather or crop-risk warnings for your farm right now.
alertsUnavailableBody: Add a farm location or refresh when you have a connection.
alertOpenHint: Opens the alert details and recommended action
alertStaleNotice: These alerts use a saved forecast and may have changed. Pull down to refresh.
alertExpiredTitle: This alert is no longer active
alertExpiredBody: It may have expired or been replaced by newer farm conditions.
alertStormBody: Heavy rain, thunderstorms or damaging weather may affect your area.
alertStormAction: Tie up support poles, move animals and equipment under cover, clear drainage and delay spraying or fertiliser.
alertRainBody: Rain may disrupt field work and leave water standing around crops.
alertRainAction: Hold off on irrigation and spraying, check field drainage and protect recently harvested produce.
alertHeatBody: High temperatures can stress crops, workers and livestock.
alertHeatAction: Water early in the morning or after sunset, check young plants for wilting and avoid strenuous midday work.
alertFrostBody: Very low temperatures may damage seedlings and sensitive crops.
alertFrostAction: Protect young plants where possible. Light evening irrigation can help the soil retain warmth.
alertWindBody: Strong wind may damage plants and carry spray away from its target.
alertWindAction: Delay spraying, secure loose covers and supports, and inspect taller crops after the wind passes.
alertDiseaseRiskBody: Repeated wet or very humid conditions may increase fungal disease risk. This is a weather-based risk, not a confirmed outbreak.
alertDiseaseRiskAction: Inspect lower leaves and dense growth each day, improve airflow where practical, avoid wetting leaves late in the day and ask a local expert before treating.
homeBlogsBody: Read the latest farming advice in English and Urdu
homeBlogsHint: Opens the latest crop guides and farming articles
